wording: A tree-geography permutation test with eight languages had power 1.00, 0.94 and 0.43 at geographic noise 0.25, 0.5 and 1.0 ('power >= 0.8' not supported at noise 1.0) (null rejection 0.04-0.07); 16 languages restored power to 0.88 at noise 1.0. counterevidence_limits: Balanced equal-branch trees and a Mantel-type statistic, not P06's trees or test.
